summary: Spark2.5 now explicitly selects the exact GELU fused path required by its reference model contract. A regression instantiates the actual Spark2_5MLP activation selection and compares representative float32 GPU tensors, including boundary inputs, with Transformers ACT2FN["gelu"] at rtol=1e-6 and atol=1e-6.

tests.what_was_measured: Preserved regression failure: Spark2_5MLP selected tanh and its fused GPU output differed from reference GELU. Raw output: /job/test-output/spark2_5-before.txt

Both the Spark2_5MLP exact-GELU contract and fused GPU output parity with Transformers ACT2FN["gelu"] passed without tolerance weakening (rtol=1e-6, atol=1e-6). Raw output: /job/test-output/spark2_5-final.txt

On an AMD Instinct MI355X (gfx950), exact fused output had max absolute and relative error 0 against Transformers GELU for 4,106 finite boundary/random results; the old tanh path had max absolute error 0.0009351540. Against an independent scalar float64 erf formulation, float32 fused output max absolute error was 3.6508846e-07. Raw output: /job/test-output/spark2_5-numerics.txt

gpu_execution.evidence: The regression and numerical script executed the fused activation on the assigned AMD Instinct MI355X, gfx950:sramecc+:xnack-.

remaining_limitations: No full Spark-X2.5 checkpoint was downloaded and no end-to-end logit comparison was run. This change does not modify FlyDSL C++ or another native source, so no native rebuild was applicable. Source paths: /job/repo/python/sglang/srt/models/spark2_5.py and /job/repo/test/srt/models/test_spark2_5.py.
